```sql
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
materials AS (
    SELECT sku, standard_cost_nzd
    FROM staging.stg_erp__materials
),
-- 1. POS Revenue and Standard Cost (November 2025: 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-30)
pos_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        p.sku,
        p.quantity,
        p.line_total,
        s.currency
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines p
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON p.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE p.txn_date >= DATE '2025-11-01' 
      AND p.txn_date <= DATE '2025-11-30'
      AND p.is_valid = TRUE
),
pos_calc AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN currency = 'AUD' THEN line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE line_total
        END AS rev,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN 
                CASE 
                    WHEN currency = 'AUD' THEN line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                    ELSE line_total
                END
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS costed_rev,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN m.standard_cost_nzd * quantity
            ELSE 0 
        END AS total_cost
    FROM pos_lines p
    LEFT JOIN materials m ON p.sku = m.sku
    LEFT JOIN fx ON p.txn_date = fx.rate_date
),

-- 2. E-commerce Revenue and Standard Cost
ecom_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, currency, order_date
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders
    WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'
      AND order_date >= DATE '2025-11-01'
      AND order_date <= DATE '2025-11-30'
),
ecom_lines_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        l.order_id,
        l.sku,
        l.quantity,
        l.line_total,
        o.currency,
        o.order_date
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
    JOIN ecom_orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
),
ecom_calc AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN currency = 'AUD' THEN line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE line_total
        END AS rev,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN 
                CASE 
                    WHEN currency = 'AUD' THEN line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                    ELSE line_total
                END
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS costed_rev,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN m.standard_cost_nzd * quantity
            ELSE 0 
        END AS total_cost
    FROM ecom_lines_raw e
    LEFT JOIN materials m ON e.sku = m.sku
    LEFT JOIN fx ON e.order_date = fx.rate_date
),

-- 3. Wholesale (ERP Sales Orders) Revenue and Standard Cost
erp_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        l.net_value,
        l.quantity,
        l.currency,
        l.order_date,
        m.standard_cost_nzd
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON l.material_id = m.material_id
    WHERE l.order_date >= DATE '2025-11-01'
      AND l.order_date <= DATE '2025-11-30'
),
erp_calc AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN currency = 'AUD' THEN net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE net_value
        END AS rev,
        CASE 
            WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN 
                CASE 
                    WHEN currency = 'AUD' THEN net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                    ELSE net_value
                END
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS costed_rev,
        CASE 
            WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN standard_cost_nzd * quantity
            ELSE 0 
        END AS total_cost
    FROM erp_lines e
    LEFT JOIN fx ON e.order_date = fx.rate_date
),

combined AS (
    SELECT rev, costed_rev, total_cost FROM pos_calc
    UNION ALL
    SELECT rev, costed_rev, total_cost FROM ecom_calc
    UNION ALL
    SELECT rev, costed_rev, total_cost FROM erp_calc
)

SELECT 
    SUM(costed_rev - total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(costed_rev), 0) AS answer
FROM combined
```
